[[File:Rada's blessing 4 detail.png|left|130x200px]]
'''Rada's blessing 4''' is an [[Achievement diary]] reward for completing all [[Kourend & Kebos Diary Elite|elite Kourend & Kebos Diary]] tasks. It is given by [[Elise]] in the [[Kourend Castle]] courtyard, and can be retrieved for free if lost. Multiple can be obtained for free. Players can also trade with [[Perdu]] who sells blessings for 200 coins each, this is especially handy if buying bulk as [[Perdu]] allows the player to buy a full inventory at once. It can be stored in a [[tackle box]].

Rada's blessing 4 gives the best-in-slot [[prayer bonus]] for the ammunition slot at +2, surpassing [[god blessing]]s.

==Benefits==
;When worn
* 8% chance to catch two fish at once everywhere (with [[Fishing enhancers#Exceptions|some exceptions]]) when equipped, the message {{Mes|Rada's blessing enabled you to catch an extra fish.}} will be displayed (no additional XP is given and no extra bait is consumed).
* Additional +1 to blessing's prayer bonus compared to the [[Rada's blessing 3]]
;When worn or in the player's inventory
* Unlimited teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
* Unlimited teleports to [[Mount Karuulm]]
[[Kourend & Kebos Diary#Rewards_4|A number of other benefits]] are always active upon claiming rewards from the elite tier of the Kourend and Kebos diary.
